title: System 2 — RAG Output Schema
description: Schema for the dict returned by fact_check_claim() (System 2). This is the 'rag_output' value inside full_pipeline()'s combined result, and is what System 3 (VerdictEngine.decide()) consumes directly as an in-memory Python dict — there is no intermediate file.

dialect.description: Detected Arabic dialect of the claim.

query_used.description: The (possibly normalized/reformulated) query actually sent to retrieval.

verdict_signal.description: System 2's internal retrieval-tier signal, before System 3 fusion.

final_verdict.description: System 2's OWN verdict based purely on retrieval (NOT the final fused verdict — System 3 may override this).

bucket_a.description: Top candidates from the verified-claims DB (cosine similarity, E5-large). Empty array if no candidates.

label.description: Ground-truth label of the matched claim.

suspicious_match.description: NEW (added this fix). True = this match likely a coincidental near-neighbor, NOT a real match — should NOT be trusted even if similarity >= 0.75. Computed via lexical-overlap (<0.20) and cross-encoder sanity check (<0), for any candidate with similarity >= 0.75 (previously only computed for similarity >= 0.84). Only attached to the top-ranked candidate (index 0). System 3 should treat a missing/undefined value as True (fail-safe: assume suspicious if unknown).

bucket_b.description: Top reranked candidates from the live news corpus (RRF E5+BM25, cross-encoder reranked). Empty if not searched or nothing found.

proposition_display.description: Decontextualized version, only present on the top hit.

rerank_score.description: Cross-encoder score, roughly in [-8, 10] before normalization.

bucket_b_searched.description: Whether Bucket B was queried at all (False if Bucket A returned a HIGH-tier non-suspicious match and Bucket B was skipped).

classifier_signal.description: System 1's (Sarah) output, passed through UNCHANGED. See output_schema.json (System 1) for the full definition of this nested object.
